connectors.title: Connected Apps
connectors.subtitle: AI clients you have connected to Aexy over MCP. Each one was authorized by you at a consent screen and can only reach the workspace you picked.
connectors.footer: Revoking takes effect immediately. The client is not told — it finds out on its next request, and has to ask for consent again to return.

empty.title: No connected apps
empty.description: When you connect a client like ChatGPT to Aexy, it will appear here so you can see what it reaches and cut it off.
